package: @astryxdesign/core

# useOverlayHookUsage - A product card that is its own overlay container: useOverlay returns the ref and props to spread on the Card and a bottom strip to render once over the image. Hovering the card, or moving keyboard focus into it, slides in a Quick view button along the bottom of the image, and leaving hides it again. The image is a link that the strip leaves clickable above it, and Tab lands on it first so the next Tab reaches Quick view.
# Components: AspectRatio, Card

<Card padding={0} width={280}>
  <AspectRatio />
  <VStack padding={3} gap={1}>
    <Text />
    <Text />
  </VStack>
</Card>
